reasons.industrial: Stationary heavy industry/oil and differentiated real-world transport; no teleport freight.
reasons.biomes: One major biome pack plus smaller thematic ecosystems; keep vanilla vertical limits.
reasons.structures: Replace distinct vanilla landmarks and add small exploration sites; not economic cities.
reasons.building: Different structural shapes, framing, paths, bridges and architectural parts; no tech gating on decoration.
reasons.food: Tea, crops, underground rations and farm processing; no temperature locks or compulsory hunger penalties.
reasons.performance: Different measured-subsystem candidates; client optimizations remain client-unverified.
reasons.qol: Recipe conflict selection and building assistance; no portable bulk cargo.
